# nestjs-twilio

> Injectable Twilio client for NestJS, with webhook signature validation, TwiML
> response serialization, Twilio-to-HTTP error mapping and multi-account support.

- Documentation: https://nestjs-twilio.lazar.sh
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/nestjs-twilio
- Source: https://github.com/lkaric/nestjs-twilio
- License: MIT

## Install

```bash
npm install nestjs-twilio twilio
```

`twilio` is a peer dependency. Peer ranges: `@nestjs/common` and `@nestjs/core`
`^11 || ^12`, `twilio` `^5 || ^6`, `reflect-metadata` `^0.1.12 || ^0.2.0`,
`rxjs` `^7.8`. `@nestjs/terminus` is an optional peer. Requires Node.js >=20.19.

## Register

```ts
import { TwilioModule } from 'nestjs-twilio';

@Module({
  imports: [
    TwilioModule.forRoot({
      accountSid: process.env.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID,
      authToken: process.env.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN,
      // Any twilio ClientOpts key is accepted at this level, e.g. region, edge.
      isGlobal: true,
    }),
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}
```

`forRootAsync({ imports, useFactory, inject })` is available for async
configuration. Credentials are validated at bootstrap and throw a
`BadRequestException` naming the missing field.

## Inject

```ts
import { InjectTwilio, TwilioService } from 'nestjs-twilio';
import type { Twilio } from 'twilio';

// Raw SDK client
constructor(@InjectTwilio() private readonly twilio: Twilio) {}

// Or the wrapper service, exposing `.client`
constructor(private readonly twilioService: TwilioService) {}
```

## Features

- **Webhook signature validation** — `TwilioWebhookGuard` and the
  `@TwilioWebhook()` decorator. Handles form-encoded and JSON bodies, and
  reconstructs the signed URL behind a proxy via `X-Forwarded-Proto` and
  `X-Forwarded-Host`.
- **TwiML responses** — `TwimlInterceptor` serializes `VoiceResponse`,
  `MessagingResponse` and `FaxResponse` to XML and sets `Content-Type`.
- **Error mapping** — `TwilioExceptionFilter` maps the SDK's `RestException` to
  a Nest `HttpException`, preserving the Twilio error code and `more_info`.
- **Multi-account** — `TwilioModule.forFeature(name, options)` and
  `forFeatureAsync(name, options)` register named clients, injected with
  `@InjectTwilio(name)`. Tokens come from `getTwilioClientToken(name)`.
- **Dual ESM + CJS** with an `exports` map; decorator metadata is preserved in
  both builds.

## Public exports

All public symbols are exported from the package root: `TwilioModule`,
`TwilioService`, `InjectTwilio`, `getTwilioClientToken`, `TwilioWebhookGuard`,
`TwilioWebhook`, `TwimlInterceptor`, `TwilioExceptionFilter`, plus the option
and payload types. Deep imports into `nestjs-twilio/dist/**` are not supported.
